business.name: Vaughn Auto Service
business.crossStreet: Between Pleasant Valley and Burton, next to the tire shop. Park in back.
business.serviceArea: Austin, Riverside, Montopolis, Del Valle, Sunset Valley, South Congress, Pflugerville and Round Rock. Free tow within 8 miles on repairs over $400.

services.name: Brake repair
services.line: Pads, rotors, calipers and lines. We measure what's left and send you the photo.

services.name: Oil & filter change
services.line: Conventional or full synthetic, with a 20-point look-over. About 30 minutes.

services.name: Check-engine diagnostics
services.line: Traced to the actual cause, not a guessed part. Free when we do the repair.

services.name: A/C repair
services.line: Leak test, recharge, compressors and condensers. Same-day on most of it.

services.name: Transmission service
services.line: Fluid and filter, slipping, hard shifts, and full rebuilds with a 3-year warranty.

services.name: Texas state inspection
services.line: Official station. Walk in, no appointment, usually out in 20 minutes.

special.title: $25 off any brake job
special.body: Mention the website when you call. Includes the inspection and the road test.
special.fine: One per vehicle, through the end of the month.

cards.title: Big repair? You can pay it out.
cards.body: Snap Finance and Synchrony Car Care, approved in about 60 seconds at the counter. 6 months interest-free on repairs over $299.

cards.title: While it's here
cards.body: Free local shuttle inside 5 miles, loaner car for jobs over two days, and after-hours key drop at the front door.

owner.name: Rick Vaughn
owner.title: Owner
owner.note: I opened this shop in 2004 after eleven years at a Ford dealer, and most of the people who come in now were sent by somebody we already fixed a car for. That only works if we tell people the truth about what their car needs — including when it doesn't need anything. If you've been quoted something you're not sure about, bring the estimate in and I'll look at it with you.
owner.photoAlt: Technician working on a car in the shop

reasons.title: You see it before we fix it
reasons.body: We text a photo or short video of the worn part with the price next to it and wait for your yes.

reasons.title: The estimate is the bill
reasons.body: If we find something else under there, we stop and call you before spending another dollar.

reasons.title: We'll tell you it can wait
reasons.body: Plenty of things are fine another year. You'll hear that from us more than you're used to.

reviews.name: Marisol R.
reviews.text: Dealer quoted $1,900 for rear brakes and a transmission flush. Vaughn did the brakes for $640 and told me the transmission was fine — sent photos of both.

reviews.name: Dale W.
reviews.text: Check engine light nobody else could figure out. They found a cracked vacuum line in about an hour and only charged me for the hour.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: A/C died in July. In the next morning, leaking condenser, done by 4pm. And somebody actually calls you back when they say they will.

copy.headline: Brakes, engines and A/C — fixed right, usually the same day
copy.tagline: Independent shop on East Riverside. ASE certified techs, written estimates before we start, and a text with photos so you can see what we found.
copy.heroFinePrint: Walk-ins welcome for inspections · After-hours key drop at the front door
copy.servicesLede: Starting prices below are real. You get a written estimate before anything gets taken apart, and a call if we find something the estimate didn't cover.
copy.footerCredentials: ASE certified technicians · 24 month / 24,000 mile warranty

seo.description: Independent auto repair shop on East Riverside in Austin. Brakes, engine diagnostics, A/C, transmission and Texas state inspections. ASE certified. Call (512) 555-0147.
